surge: Initial speed only; all six rigid-body DOFs free
boundary: DBC tank and piston; mDBC1 hull normals only
particle_mass_policy: GenCase default fluid interaction mass; independent physical rigid-body mass
limitations: Coarse demonstration, not a validated seakeeping or resistance prediction.
Impulsive initial body velocity in initially still water creates a startup transient.
Finite tank, artificial viscosity, unresolved near-wall flow and no collisions/flooding model.
Head-on waves and symmetry can keep sway, roll and yaw small even though those DOFs are free.
